steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. Each scheduled change is placed in the order it runs in the fortnight.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: High-risk change with no approver
findings.fix: Get an approver before the change runs

findings.title: Failed change with no review
findings.fix: Review the failure and record the cause

outcome.notChecked: Whether the change worked as intended.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.

[medium] chg-wk2-sec.md:19  Failed change with no review.

pros: Flags a high-risk change with no approver, a change with no rollback, and a failed change with no review.
cons: Not checked: Whether the change worked as intended.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-techops-change-review skill on the records for this review.
